args.title: Fix README "Running locally" step referencing missing npm run serve
args.body:
File: README.md

Step 5 of "Running locally" tells readers to run `npm run build` followed by `npm run serve`, but `serve` is not a script defined in package.json (the available scripts are `start`, `build`, `test`, and `lint`). Following the README as written fails with "Missing script: serve".

Update that step to use `npm run start` (or simply `npm start`) in place of `npm run serve`, so the documented command matches the actual scripts in package.json.
